data.cultural_impact: The name 'Palanivel' is deeply rooted in Tamil culture. It signifies the individual's devotion and dedication towards one of the most revered deities in Hinduism, Lord Hanuman. data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Palanivel' holds great spiritual significance for Hindu devotees. The prefix 'Pala' meaning 'servant' signifies the devotee's commitment and surrender to the divine power of Lord Hanuman. The suffix 'Ani' means 'Lord', thereby establishing Lord Hanuman as the ultimate master and guide for the individual. This name serves as a constant reminder to the individual of their devotion and commitment to their beloved deity, instilling a strong sense of faith and spirituality in their daily lives.
